stem:
Kabir's class evaporates seawater to grow salt crystals for a science display. The same kind of crystallization leaves a hard white crust on a cooking pan they want to keep clean.

Mark each statement true (T) or false (F).

statements.text: Growing salt crystals for the display is desirable in that situation.
The white crust on the cooking pan is undesirable when the purpose is to keep the pan clean.
Crystallization is always desirable because the change is named crystallization.

teacher.key_rationale: The same change can be desirable or undesirable depending on situation and purpose. Display crystals are wanted; pan crust is not. The change name alone does not decide.
